text:
Sana: starting ThunderBench POC for Prospect. Goal: sustained 140 qps gen, with controlled microbursts to 2200 qps for 20s. Need runbook, cost estimate, BYOK flow, and SOC2 copy. @Lina please own test plan. @Ethan infra.
Lina: on it. quick: avg prompt tokens? gen length? embed %? redaction requirement?
Sana: prompt ~300 tokens, gen ~180. embeddings ~4% of traffic. yes, redact PII.
Marco: security ask: BYOK (HSM optional), TLS1.3 enforced, vendor questionnaire due Fri.
Ethan: infra note: Hosted can handle spikes with prewarm but expect transient 5xx at ramp without prewarm. estimate transient Hosted marginal cost ~ $1.7k/hr during spike windows. Dedicated recommended if they want predictable billing.
Lina: draft runbook:
1) provision test cluster with KMS alias
2) smoke 40 qps
3) concurrency sweep to 200
4) sustained 140 qps 25m
5) run 20s & 60s bursts at 2200 qps
Collect p50/p95/p99, 5xx, GPU util, kvcache hit rate. sample cmd: `rbx-load --target 140 --spike 2200 --dur 20 --model redwood-13b-q4_0 --prewarm 600`
deploy-bot: cluster created id=thunder-poc-11, nodes=6, endpoint=thunder-poc-11.redwood.internal:443
Ethan: smoke run summary: 40 qps p95 110ms p99 380ms; 140 qps p95 220ms p99 960ms; 2200 qps spike tail ~1.9s, few 5xx at spike start. prewarm+retries removes 5xx. attached small CSV.
Sana: good. Lina please post final runbook + cost workbook Mon EOD and include Hosted vs Dedicated SLA tradeoffs.
Lina: will upload runbook to internal drive and generate customer redacted copy once security signs off.
Eng-SRE: standby for rehearsal Tue 09:00 PT. We'll monitor p99 and autoscale events.
Sana: demo targeted Thu 10am PT pending rehearsal. confirming Tue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
